emergencyNotice.title: Emergency Care Comes First
emergencyNotice.signsHeader: Signs that need emergency care right away:
emergencyNotice.sign4: Fainting, collapse, or not waking up
emergencyNotice.sign5: Sudden weakness or a drooping face
emergencyNotice.sign6: Serious injury, deep wound or fracture
emergencyNotice.sign7: Pregnant woman who is bleeding or in severe pain
emergencyNotice.sign8: Child who is very unwell or unresponsive
emergencyNotice.anyOfThese: Any of these? Go to Emergency now. You do not need a token or registration.
emergencyNotice.noEmergencyContinue: None of these — Continue to Regular OPD Registration
